spans.s:
n. (-नं)
1 Disrespect, disregard, contempt.
2 Wantoning, dalliance.
E.
हिस्न to disregard, aff. ल्युट्.

f. (-ला)
1 Wanton dalliance, lascivious endearment.
2 Disrespect, contempt.
3 Moonlight.
E.
हिल to dally, aff. अच् and टाप्.

m. (-लिः)
The sun.
f. (-लिः)
Dalliance, wanton sport.
E.
हिस्न to dally, Uṇādi aff. इन्.
